Review Rork ?

Reviewers mostly see Rork as a fast way to turn prompts into working mobile apps, especially MVPs, internal tools, and small personal projects, with strong UI quality and a smoother mobile-focused experience than some alternatives. The makers of Spiritme and SocLeads echo that it is useful for quickly testing ideas and building small apps. Still, praise is tempered by repeated complaints about crashes, black screens, persistent errors, missing app features, publishing friction, and uneven or absent support.
